name: Should I paint over a popcorn ceiling or remove the texture first?

mainEntity.name: Should I paint over a popcorn ceiling or remove the texture first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repainting over popcorn texture is straightforward if the texture is bonded securely and has been painted before. However, if the texture is raw, brittle, or disintegrating, adding the weight of heavy wet paint can cause whole sections to loosen and fall. In older homes, removing the popcorn texture entirely and skim-coating the ceiling smooth provides a modernized look and prevents future texture failure. A contractor can evaluate texture integrity and test for underlying issues before you commit to painting over an unstable ceiling.
acceptedAnswer.description: If the popcorn is intact and previously painted, repainting works well; if it is unpainted, flaking, or brittle, full removal and skim-coating is the better route.
